Frequently Asked Questions

How long do outdoor vinyl banners last?

Frontlit 440gsm: 1 year outdoor. 510gsm: 2 years. Blockout: 3 years. Mesh: 2 years. UV-stable inks prevent fading for 2+ years in direct sun.

What's the maximum size you can print?

Single piece: 5m wide × 50m long seamless. Larger sizes use heat-welded seams with reinforced overlap. We mark seam lines on artwork pre-production.

Are they waterproof and wind-resistant?

Yes. All banners are printed with waterproof solvent/UV inks. Mesh banners (270–340gsm) are wind-permeable for high-wind zones. Solid vinyls handle winds up to 50km/h with proper grommet spacing.

What finishing do you include by default?

Welded hems on all four sides, brass grommets every 50cm on all four edges, and white outer edges to prevent fraying. Pole pockets and wind slits are optional add-ons.

Can I install them on a fence or scaffolding?

Yes. We provide cable ties, bungee cords, and zip-tie templates. For scaffolding, mesh banners reduce wind load. For fences, grommet-and-cable is standard. Ask for our install guide.

How fast can I get one?

Standard production: 3-5 business days. Rush: 24h for orders under 50 sqm. DHL Express ships in 2-4 days to US, UK, AU, KR, SG, AE.

Use Cases & Industries

Restaurants use them for window menus and grand-opening banners. Event organizers use them for venue wayfinding and step-and-repeat backdrops. Schools and offices use them for indoor wall murals, donor walls, and motivational signage. Real estate agents use them for open-house window decals. Frequently Asked Questions

Can the adhesive vinyl be removed without damage?

Yes — our removable adhesive peels off cleanly within 90 days on glass, painted walls, finished wood, and metal. Beyond 90 days, adhesive may begin to cure. For long-term installs, choose permanent vinyl.

What's the maximum print size?

Single piece: 150cm wide × any length in one roll. Larger banners seam-overlap. We mark seam lines on artwork pre-production for clean assembly.

Will it stick to textured walls?

Smooth painted walls, glass, finished wood, and metal: yes. Textured walls, brick, raw wood, or stucco: limited adhesion. For textured surfaces, we recommend wall-mural vinyl with high-tack adhesive.

How long do they last outdoors?

Removable vinyl: 6 months outdoor. Permanent monomeric: 3 years. Polymeric: 5 years. Adding UV laminate extends life by 2x.

Can you cut custom shapes?

Yes. Plotter cutting to any outline — letters, logos, complex shapes. Submit a vector die-line (AI/PDF) and we cut from your file. Custom shapes add 1 day to production.

How do I install them?

For glass: clean with isopropyl alcohol, peel backing, apply with squeegee, trim edges. For walls: same prep, low-tack repositionable within 30 min. We include a squeegee and instruction card with every order.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a vehicle wrap last?

Cast vinyl + lamination: 5-7 years outdoor. Partial wraps in shaded garages last 8-10 years. Direct-sun vehicles (delivery vans) typically need replacement at 5 years.

Can I install the wrap myself?

Spot graphics and small decals: DIY-friendly. Partial or full wraps: professional install strongly recommended. We provide a panel-by-panel plotter cut file for installers, or refer you to a local partner.

Will the wrap damage the original paint?

No. Quality cast vinyl protects the underlying paint from UV and minor scratches. When professionally removed within 5-7 years, original paint remains intact.

What about windows — can I wrap them?

Yes. Perforated window film (one-way vision) lets you print on windows while maintaining visibility from inside. Used widely on commercial fleets.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between mesh and solid vinyl?

Mesh is perforated (10-20% open) for air permeability. Reduces wind load by 30-40%. Solid vinyl is opaque, vibrant color, and tear-resistant but not wind-permeable. Use mesh for high-wind, scaffolding, and large areas.

How long do mesh banners last outdoors?

Standard 310gsm: 2-3 years outdoor. Heavy 340gsm with UV lamination: 3-5 years. Direct coastal / tropical sun: replace at 2 years. Inland: 3-5 years typical.

Can mesh print photo-quality images?

Premium coated mesh (340gsm, 8% open) supports near-photo quality. Standard 310gsm is good for text, logos, and bold graphics. For photo-realistic output, request the premium grade.

How do I install mesh on a chain-link fence?

Use cable ties (zip ties) every 30cm through grommets. For tall fences, add a top support cable. For 50+ meter runs, use wind slits on solid sections. We include install instructions with every order.

What's the maximum size?

Single piece: 5m wide × 50m long seamless. Larger sizes heat-welded with reinforced overlap. We mark seam lines on artwork pre-production.
